function.name: run_sql
function.arguments: {"sql":"SELECT vb.vendor_invoice_no, COUNT(*) AS bill_cnt, COUNT(vp.txn_id) AS payment_cnt FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor_bill vb LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor_payment vp ON vb.vendor_invoice_no = vp.vendor_invoice_no WHERE vb.period='2026-09' GROUP BY vb.vendor_invoice_no HAVING COUNT(*) \u003e 1","purpose":"Find duplicate vendor bills in Sep 2026"}
